blockers: The proposed stack baseline is not authoritative until human-merged into protected main in dependency order, and the local product candidate is still an uncommitted worktree.

No hosted deployment has measured availability, latency, recovery, security, or cost against the proposed budgets.
Production branch rules, required checks, merge strategy, and proposer non-bypass must be verified and enforced by the human maintainer.
The candidate has not been promoted by human merge and release.
Effectiveness and composition evidence is incomplete.
